subject: The anatomical knee exactly as in the start frame: only the bones and the tendon, no muscle layer, the kneecap a smooth rounded bone.

The anatomy takes the weight — it is not a still model with light played over it. Still loading at the cut. The anatomy keeps its structure every frame: bones hold shape, length and spacing, joints never separate or pass through each other, muscle keeps constant volume, and the layer order holds — bone deepest, muscle over it, translucent contour outermost.
